content: अवहारः [अवहृ-कर्तरि ण <ls>P. III. 1. 141</ls>] .²1 A thief. .²2 A shark, a water elephant. .²3 Taking away the wealth of invited Brāhmaṇas. .²4 Temporary cessation of hostilities, suspension of arms, truce; एवं राजन्नवहारो बभूव <ls>Mb. 5. 182. 30</ls>, <ls n="Mb.">1. 190. 35</ls>. .²5 Removing to the camp; ततोऽवहारं सैन्यानां तव तेषां च भारत <ls>Mb.</ls> .²6 Cessation, stop (in general). .²7 Summoning, inviting. .²8 Any object fit to be brought near (उपनेतव्यम्). .²9 Apostacy, abandoning a sect or caste. .²10 Redelivery, redeeming. .²11 One who snatches away; न जीवस्यावहारो मां करोति सुखिनं यमः <ls>Bk. 6. 81</ls>.
